# M6 early abort (generated by scripts/m6_summary.py)

Score: MWPM gap and prefix gap, RL prior. Policy family learned on Train (Q-iteration, Dinkelbach on kept shots per round), Learn-then-Test on Calibrate (delta = 0.05), evaluated on Test. 84 experiments (r = 10, 30, 50). Uncertified experiments keep nothing. Per-experiment rows: `results/m6_early_abort.csv`; certified policies: `results/m6_policies.csv`.

## Does the certificate hold on Test?

| Rule | Certified (experiment, alpha) cells | Exceed alpha | Significantly exceed |
|---|---|---|---|
| static | 193 | 3 (1.6%) | 0 (0.0%) |
| final_only | 204 | 7 (3.4%) | 0 (0.0%) |
| early_abort | 205 | 12 (5.9%) | 0 (0.0%) |

Significant: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound above alpha. Cells sharing an experiment are not independent.

## Kept shots per round of hardware time

Throughput = kept Test shots / rounds used by all attempted Test shots. Ratios are medians over experiments where both rules certify. E: early abort, F: final-only ablation (same keep thresholds, never aborts), S: static rule of M4 (5% keep grid).

## Q-learning check

For every experiment, the batch Q-table (one backward sweep) was recomputed by sample-by-sample Q-learning with a target table refreshed every epoch: largest difference 9.8e-14; identical decisions in 84 of 84 experiments.

## How much the prefix says about the final decision

Test shots, mid-run checkpoint. Spearman: rank correlation between the prefix gap and the final gap. Lift: how often a shot in the lowest fifth of prefix gaps is kept by a top-20% final-gap rule, relative to the average shot (0 = never kept, 1 = no information).

| d | r | Checkpoint round | Spearman | Lift |

| 3 | 10 | 5 | 0.52 | 0.04 |
| 3 | 30 | 15 | 0.53 | 0.22 |
| 3 | 50 | 25 | 0.54 | 0.22 |
| 5 | 10 | 5 | 0.39 | 0.35 |
| 5 | 30 | 15 | 0.46 | 0.45 |
| 5 | 50 | 25 | 0.48 | 0.42 |
| 7 | 10 | 5 | 0.29 | 0.50 |
| 7 | 30 | 15 | 0.38 | 0.61 |

## Under shift (RQ3 for policies)

Policy certified on the source (Train, Calibrate), played unchanged on the target's Test split, with the source's bin edges. Each cell: share of certified pairs whose target Test error significantly exceeds alpha, then the number of certified pairs; early abort first, the static thresholds of M5 (threshold transfer, same round counts 10, 30, 50) second. Pairs sharing a source are not independent. Rows: `results/m6_drift.csv`.

| Shift | alpha = 1e-3 | alpha = 1e-2 | alpha = 1e-1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Same experiment | 0% / 3 vs 0% / 4 | 0% / 37 vs 0% / 36 | 0% / 78 vs 0% / 73 |
